title: AI was supposed to win people over by now — it hasn’t
summary: Yet there are still those surprised by consumers’ reaction. Some in Silicon Valley may think this stems from a messaging problem: that perhaps execs need to explain AI better to consumers, so people can fully understand its benefits.
